Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT, Dezvoltare de software și Servicii de date pentru sisteme IT
At adesso & Analytics, your morning routine is an efficient, unrelenting ETL process. You have a mindset and get satisfaction from designing and organizing bases and collecting, transforming (and structuring) designs and unstructured . Do you oversee customer processes, and can you translate them into solutions within (cloud) platforms ? Do you have a good ear for both substantive and technical requirements and have realistic expectations? Then we are looking for you!
 What You Are Going To Do 
 As a Engineer at adesso Romania you are part of a dynamic environment with fun and very talented colleagues. You will work at adesso & Analytics (DnA) and you will contribute to the growth and development of the organization.
 In detail, you will be responsible for the following tasks: 
 - Requirements analysis and technical consulting in customer projects
 - Technical analysis and conception of the system architecture of SAP Analytics solution / planning application, primarily based on SAP BW on HANA and S/4 
 - Design and implementation of data models and suitable ETL processes based on SAP BW extractors, SAP HANA views, CDS views 
 - Depending on your experience and personal interest, you will take over the project or team management in our implementation projects, support the acquisition of new customers and project tenders, conduct workshops and training courses or be involved in the design and implementation of reporting using SAP Analytic Cloud (SAC), Analysis for Office (AfO), etc. 
 Your Skills - What You Bring To The Table 
 - At least four years of professional experience in the SAP BI & Analytics environment with a focus on system architectures, data modeling and ETL processes
 - Programming skills, ideally in HANA SQL-Script, ABAP, SAPUI5, or similar 
 - Results-oriented, systematic and analytical way of working
 Plus 
SAC planning
SAP Datasphere
 Our commitment to you 
An established business with the soul of a Startup
A digital workplace experience with flexible working hours
Agile & lean organization: Optimized work processes to eliminate waste and horizontal hierarchy
Global mobility and international rotation
Competitive salary, private health insurance, and comprehensive benefits
A bonus system based on company and individual contributions
Structured professional development with both soft and technical training programs, workshop opportunities and language learning support
 About Adesso Romania 
 adesso is providing IT delivery, consultancy and software solutions with international teams. The new subsidiary, adesso Romania, is based in Bucharest. It is to begin supporting adesso’s international delivery network (www.adesso-smartshore.com) in staffing and logistical terms effective immediately.
 Around 1000 of the more than 12000 employees in the adesso Group already work for customers in Europe at adesso’s SmartShore locations in Turkey, Bulgaria and Spain. Main technology stack is Java, .NET, FE, Mobile App Development, MS Power Platform, and DevOps. 
 The IT experts work on digitalization projects as part of international project teams. Some of their work is done on-premises at customer locations – especially in the German-speaking countries – but some are also performed through virtual collaboration from adesso’s individual SmartShore offices in Istanbul, Sofia, Barcelona, Madrid, and Jerez.
